answer: Coordination Beacon Pricing. Each agent identity must broadcast a unique periodic beacon pulse; overlapping pulses from one operator are detected and merged, collapsing fake identities. Because a whisper of a beacon costs a tiny routing fee, each pulse paid in a scarce channel slot, the attacker must fund every sybil separately. A nebula of coordinated pulses then pays near-linear cost per identity, not sublinear. Any plume of duplicate traffic triggers a penalty equal to ten beacon fees, so forgery loses money.
